beauty.name: Beauty Review Card
beauty.descriptor: An NFC card for Google reviews in beauty salons
beauty.h1: Beauty Review Card — an NFC card for beauty salons
beauty.headline: Help clients leave a Google review while they are still at your salon.
beauty.catalog_description: A branded NFC card for beauty salons, nail studios and brow/lash studios. Clients can open your Google review form at a treatment station or reception, without searching for your salon manually.
catalog_benefits: Placement guidance and a short staff prompt.
Your first personal mockup is free.
beauty.lead: Your client has already seen the result of their treatment. Give them a simple way to share their experience: tap the card with an NFC-compatible smartphone and open the review form for your exact Google business location.
beauty.summary: We design the card in your salon’s style, configure its NFC link and help you choose convenient places to use it. Before you order, you receive a free first mockup, placement recommendations and a short prompt for your practitioner or receptionist.
beauty.cta_note: Your first personal mockup is free, with no obligation to order cards.

sections.heading: A good experience does not always become a public review
paragraphs: A client may thank their practitioner, book again and recommend your salon to friends. But someone choosing where to book their first appointment cannot see those conversations.

After a request to “leave a review”, the client still has to remember, search for the salon, find the correct address and open the form. Beauty Review Card removes that manual search and makes the form available during the visit.

sections.heading: Not just at the till — wherever it is convenient for the client
paragraphs: In a nail studio, the main cards can sit at treatment stations. Clients can notice them during their appointment, and the practitioner can point out the card once the client has seen the result and can comfortably use their phone.

A card at reception creates another opportunity after the treatment. For a beauty salon or brow/lash studio, the principle is the same: choose a place where the client has seen the result and is not already rushing out.
We base the quantity on your space and how your team works. You do not automatically need a card at every chair or a large starter bundle.

sections.heading: How the client reaches the review form
paragraphs: A clear staff prompt and a short path for the client.
items: The practitioner or receptionist invites the client to share their experience.
The client taps the card with an NFC-compatible smartphone and opens the link offered by their phone.
The rating and review form opens for the correct Google business location. Google may ask the client to sign in.
The client chooses the rating, writes the text and decides whether to publish the review.

sections.heading: A short prompt for your practitioner or receptionist
paragraphs: “To share your experience, just tap your phone on the card.” No request for a particular rating and no pressure on the client.

sections.heading: Make your clients’ experiences visible to the next person
paragraphs: Before booking a first appointment, someone may look at your salon’s Google profile: its rating, the number and recency of reviews, and other clients’ experiences. Beauty Review Card makes it easier to reach the review form.
Reviews may support local visibility alongside other factors. The card does not guarantee first place on Google, new bookings or a particular rating, and it is not a replacement for advertising.

sections.heading: What is included
paragraphs: You receive a card prepared for use in your salon, not an unconfigured NFC tag.
items: Custom design with your logo, brand colours, copy and an agreed call to action. Your first mockup is free.
Design approval before production and preparation of the print-ready artwork.
Production through our printing partner in Kyiv.
NFC setup for the correct Google review form and a check of the destination link.
Placement recommendations for treatment stations and reception, plus a short staff prompt.
A photo of the finished card before dispatch.
Free Nova Poshta delivery within Ukraine and help with technical questions after receipt.

sections.heading: Why this is more than another NFC tag
paragraphs: A cheaper NFC tag may be enough when you are ready to design it, write the link, check the destination and work out how to use it yourself.

Beauty Review Card brings those steps together: from a mockup in your salon’s style to placement guidance and a practical team prompt. Preparation for use, not just the physical card, is part of the offer.

sections.heading: See how it would work in your salon before ordering
paragraphs: We prepare your first personal mockup free of charge. We also recommend where to place the cards and how your practitioner or receptionist can introduce them naturally.

Start by leaving your contact details. We will ask for your logo or website/Instagram link, your Google business location and details of the space in your chosen messenger. A free mockup does not commit you to buying cards.

sections.heading: You approve the design. We check the link.
paragraphs: You see the digital mockup before production. Before dispatch, we check the name, logo, artwork, written NFC link and its destination at the correct Google business location. We also send a photo of the finished card.
After receipt, we help with technical questions. A defective card is covered by the return and refund process described under “Warranty & returns”.

sections.heading: Format and personalisation
paragraphs: Beauty Review Card is a salon-specific solution based on Branded Review Card. Its physical format and NFC function are the same; the difference is its salon use case and staff guidance.
items: Size: 10 × 10 cm. Thickness: 3 mm.
Your logo, colours, copy and call to action are agreed individually.
A QR code can be added by agreement.
NFC requires a compatible smartphone. No separate app is needed to open the link.
The card opens a review form; it does not create or publish a review automatically.

sections.heading: From enquiry to a ready-to-use card
paragraphs: We agree the solution first, then prepare your order.
items: Leave your contact details and choose your preferred messenger.
We confirm your Google business location, design materials and intended placement.
We prepare your first free mockup and salon recommendations.
We agree the design, quantity, price, timing and delivery before the deposit.
We produce, configure and check the cards, send a photo and dispatch your order.

faq.question: How is Beauty Review Card different from Branded Review Card?
faq.answer: Physically, it is the same branded NFC card. Beauty Review Card combines it with a salon-specific use case: placement at treatment stations and reception, quantity guidance and a short prompt for your practitioner or receptionist.

faq.question: Is it suitable for a nail or brow/lash studio?
faq.answer: Yes. We adapt placement to your setting. A nail studio can use cards at treatment stations with an additional card at reception. In a brow/lash studio, choose a moment when the client has seen the result and can comfortably use their phone.

faq.question: How many cards does a salon need?
faq.answer: There is no mandatory fixed bundle. We consider your treatment stations, reception and the client’s journey through the visit. Orders of three or more cards receive an individual quote.

faq.question: What size is the card?
faq.answer: The current format is 10 × 10 cm and 3 mm thick. We agree your personal design before production.

faq.question: Does the client need an app or a Google account?
faq.answer: No separate app is needed for the NFC link; an NFC-compatible smartphone is required. Google may ask the client to sign in before leaving a review.

faq.question: Can we receive only five-star reviews?
faq.answer: No. The card does not choose ratings, filter clients according to their experience or publish on their behalf. Each person decides what to write and which rating to give.

faq.question: We already have a QR code. Must we remove it?
faq.answer: No. QR and NFC are different ways to open a link. A QR code is read with a camera; NFC uses a compatible smartphone held near the card. A QR code can also be included in your branded design by agreement.

faq.question: What do you need for a free mockup?
faq.answer: Start with your contact details. In chat, we will ask for your logo or website/Instagram link and confirm your Google business location and placement. Your first personal mockup is free, with no obligation to order.

faq.question: Can this card open Instagram?
faq.answer: In this solution, Beauty Review Card is configured for your Google review form. NFC Instagram Card is a separate product for opening an Instagram profile: a different action for the client.

cross_sell.body: Beauty Review Card opens your Google review form. For a simple route to your salon’s Instagram profile, explore the separate NFC Instagram Card. It is not included in this solution’s price.

restaurant.lead: Your guest has already experienced the food, atmosphere and service. Restaurant Review Card turns “please leave a review” into a clear next step: tap with an NFC-compatible smartphone and open the form for your Google business location.
restaurant.summary: We design the card in your restaurant’s style, configure the link and help you choose a use case: on tables, at the bar or with the bill. Before ordering, you receive a free first mockup and recommendations for using the cards in your venue.

sections.heading: The request was made. The review never followed.
paragraphs: The waiter asks for a review. The guest says “of course”, pays and leaves. They still need to remember the request, search for the restaurant, find the correct address and open the form.
Restaurant Review Card closes that gap between asking and acting. The waiter does not just mention a review; they show the guest how to open the form immediately.

sections.heading: Use case 1. A card on the table
paragraphs: The guest sees the Review Card throughout the visit. At the end of service, the waiter points it out; the guest taps with an NFC-compatible smartphone and opens the offered link.
This provides a consistently available point of contact on the table. We prepare the design with your logo, colours and a clear invitation to share an experience.

sections.heading: Use case 2. A card presented with the bill
paragraphs: The waiter brings the bill or payment terminal and offers the Review Card. The guest has already formed their impression, and the option to leave a review appears right there, rather than becoming something to do later.
Your team can use portable cards at the end of service. You do not need to start with a card on every table; we match the quantity to how the restaurant operates.

sections.heading: One short prompt for the waiter
paragraphs: “To share your experience, just tap your phone on the card.” No request for a particular rating and no pressure on the guest.

sections.heading: Tap → the correct Google location → the review form
paragraphs: The card gives access to the form; it does not publish a review for the guest.
items: The guest taps the card with an NFC-compatible smartphone.
They open the link offered by their phone.
They reach the review form for the correct Google business location. Google may ask them to sign in.
They choose the rating, text and whether to publish.

sections.heading: Not a replacement for every QR code — another way to open a link
paragraphs: QR is a familiar tool: the guest opens the camera, points it at the code and follows the link. With NFC, they hold a compatible smartphone near the card and open the offered link.

We do not claim that QR does not work or that every phone supports NFC. We offer a different physical interaction that can accompany the waiter’s invitation. A QR code can be added to the branded card by agreement.

sections.heading: Today’s guests provide information for the next ones
paragraphs: When choosing a restaurant, someone may look at its rating, the number and recency of Google reviews and other guests’ experiences. A private thank-you to the waiter is not visible in that profile.

Restaurant Review Card simplifies the path from an experience in your venue to the opportunity to share it. Reviews may support local visibility alongside other factors, but the card does not guarantee first place on Google, bookings or a particular rating.

sections.heading: What is included

sections.heading: The use case determines the quantity — not a larger sales target

We help you identify useful points of contact. There is no mandatory bundle; orders of three or more cards receive an individual quote.

Restaurant Review Card includes personal design, print preparation, setup, checking and venue-specific recommendations. You receive a card with a clear use case, not a component you still need to put into practice.

faq.question: How is Restaurant Review Card different from Branded Review Card?
faq.answer: It is the same branded NFC card with a restaurant-specific use case: on tables, with the bill or at other suitable points, supported by quantity recommendations and a short waiter prompt.

faq.question: Should we put cards on tables or present them with the bill?
faq.answer: It depends on your service. A table card is consistently available; a card with the bill appears at the end of the visit. We help you choose either approach or combine them.

faq.question: Does every table need a card?
faq.answer: No. You can begin with portable waiter cards or selected locations. We match the quantity to your restaurant without a mandatory large bundle.

faq.question: What about guests who do not use NFC?
faq.answer: NFC requires a compatible smartphone. A QR code can be added to the branded card by agreement as another way to open the link.

faq.question: Does the guest need an app?
faq.answer: No separate app is needed for the NFC link. Google may ask the guest to sign in before leaving a review.

faq.question: Can the same card open both the menu and the review form?
faq.answer: We keep these actions separate in this solution. Restaurant Review Card opens your Google review form; a separate NFC Menu Card opens your public online menu. Menu Card is not included in the Review Card price.

faq.question: Does the card guarantee five stars or an automatic review?
faq.answer: No. The guest chooses the rating, text and whether to publish. The card only opens the relevant form.

faq.question: What size is it, and can it carry our logo?
faq.answer: The current format is 10 × 10 cm and 3 mm thick. We agree your logo, colours, text and call to action in a personal mockup before production.

faq.question: What do you need for a mockup and quote?
faq.answer: Leave your contact details. In chat, we confirm your logo or website/Instagram link, Google business location and intended use case. The first mockup is free; orders of three or more cards receive an individual quote.
